001package org.clafer.cli;
002
003import java.io.File;
004import java.io.PrintStream;
005import joptsimple.OptionSet;
006import org.clafer.assertion.Assertion;
007import org.clafer.compiler.ClaferAsserter;
008import org.clafer.compiler.ClaferCompiler;
009import org.clafer.compiler.ClaferOption;
010import org.clafer.compiler.ClaferSearchStrategy;
011import org.clafer.instance.InstanceClafer;
012import org.clafer.instance.InstanceModel;
013import org.clafer.javascript.JavascriptFile;
014import org.clafer.scope.Scope;
015
016
017public class Validate {
018    public static void runValidate(File inputFile, JavascriptFile javascriptFile, OptionSet options, PrintStream outStream) throws Exception {
019        //----------------------------------------
020        // Running the model itself(instantiating)
021        //----------------------------------------
022        Assertion[] assertions = javascriptFile.getAssertions();
023            // no assertions means the model is valid
024        if (assertions.length == 0)
025            return;
026
027        // handle scopes
028        Scope scope = Utils.resolveScopes(inputFile, javascriptFile, options);
029
030        // handle search strategy
031        ClaferOption compilerOption = ClaferOption.Default;
032        if (options.has("search")) {
033            compilerOption = compilerOption.setStrategy((ClaferSearchStrategy) options.valueOf("search"));
034        }
035
036        ClaferAsserter solver = ClaferCompiler.compile(javascriptFile.getModel(), scope, assertions, javascriptFile.getOption());
037
038        int index = 0; // optimal instance id
039        boolean prettify = options.has("prettify");
040        boolean addTypes = options.has("addtypes");
041
042        while (solver.find()) {
043            System.out.println("Failed assertion(s):");
044            for (Assertion failedAssertion : solver.failedAssertions())
045              System.out.println("  " + failedAssertion);
046            outStream.println("\n=== Counterexample " + (++index) + " Begin ===\n");
047            InstanceModel instance = solver.instance();
048
049            if (prettify)
050                instance.print(outStream, addTypes);
051            else {
052                for (InstanceClafer c : instance.getTopClafers())
053                    Utils.printClafer(c, outStream);
054            }
055            outStream.println("\n--- Counterexample " + (index) + " End ---\n");
056        }
057
058        if (index == 0)
059          System.out.println("No counterexamples found within the scope. All assertions may hold.");
060        else
061          System.out.println("Generated all " + index + " counterexample(s) within the scope\n");
062    }
063}
